_meta.title: Relay scale spine — where a reading sits
_meta.role: The relay's opening question, replacing the ad-hoc SCOPES list. Scale -> Field locates WHERE a situation lives; the field then selects which facet vocabulary the six elements walk. Derived from reflective/area-taxonomy.json, which models the same micro/meso/macro stratification for the (retired) retrieval track — same categories, same phrasing, plus a `track` per field.
_meta.contract: Every entry carries the four layers used site-wide: id · label · gloss · phrase.
_meta.routing: Personal -> relational, Global -> strategic, Local decided per field. A reader who names only the scale gets that scale's default.
